test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A survey was conducted on 80 families to know about their favorite place to visit out of 6 particular locations. The same has been shown in the following pie chart. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b9efe8d6403c729e7f1295bab5ea673890fc5adb88e16470ca8744cfa7a14ef.png] 

What is the central angle for the families who showed interest for visiting Jaipur?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The families who showed interest for visiting Jaipur = 15%

Now,

The central angle for the families who showed interest for visiting Jaipur = (15/100 × 360)

⇒ (5400/100)

⇒ 54° 

**∴ The required angle is 54° **
